dispute.cause: vi.mock factory did not intercept cron.ts's bound import of sendPush in @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers; the real sendPush ran against non-base64 fixture keys, threw, and was swallowed as retryable, so the spy was never called and the test failed for a reason unrelated to the route it asserts. A TS2556 compile defect in the same file also blocked tsc -b.
dispute.repair: test-writer changed only the mocking mechanism (vi.mock -> import * as ns + vi.spyOn) and the header comment; every assertion preserved verbatim. Re-validated by test-reviewer and by post-green review.
dispute.note: Both defects were present when the test-reviewer first APPROVED this suite. The earlier verdict mis-attributed the red to cron.ts hardcoding route: '/'.

interrupted_run_note: Attempt 1 ran to near-completion during a client crash and reported nothing. Its work was found on disk, verified by running the suite rather than assumed complete, and finished by attempt 2.
